body.title: Confirm the unreviewed review-cycle fixes
body.summary: Verify that each fix made after the last review round has an implementation and a test: noMerged on git_for_each_ref, expected non-zero helper outcomes for amend, reset and merge kept apart from process failures, independent stdout and stderr limits on runShellBytes, git_merge_base bases, git_fetch depth below 1 in the compatibility audit, the commit numstat read as an inventoried secondary read, the three-owner coverage test, and the git_reset and git_push lookups in the secondary-read inventory with the grep test t5 built. Fill any gap found.
acceptanceChecks: A written table maps each listed fix to the file that implements it and the test that pins it
Any fix without both is implemented or tested before the task ends
The secondary-read grep test is shown to fail when an unlisted ignored lookup is added

tests.name: src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: git_amend with no upstream, a non-ancestor and a timed-out upstream read; git_reset hard with an unknown force-push state; git_merge with a failing conflict enumeration; and git_for_each_ref noMerged

src/daemon/tools/builtins/git/__tests__/git-failures.test.ts: git_commit, git_push, git_rebase and git_checkout fail before changing anything when the current-branch or staged-count read cannot run or times out
